reason: The README describes a multimodal plugin that analyzes conversation and tool-result images and optionally generates or edits images through configured APIs, making media-tools the primary user-facing category.

summaries.zh: Vision Mix 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加图片理解、跨轮追问以及通过已配置 API 生成和编辑图片的能力。
summaries.en: Vision Mix adds image understanding, follow-up analysis, and image generation or editing through configured APIs to DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Routes text and image inputs between configured language and vision models
Calls configured image generation and editing APIs
Reads and references image attachments from the current conversation and tool results
Registers agent tools for image generation, editing, and attachment queries
Stores vision and generation call records with attachment identifiers
